nodes.name: cli_binary_resolver.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves and probes installed coding-agent CLI binaries (Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Codex, Copilot, and 20+ others) by searching the process PATH, login shell, and known install locations, returning structured metadata used to launch and version-detect external CLI tools.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses per-platform login-shell probing (with a Windows stub variant of resolve_via_login_shell) and a timeout-guarded subprocess call to safely probe CLI versions without hanging the UI thread.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Centralized registry that re-exports the integration crate's Tauri commands (currently the external-IDE open/show-in-folder commands) so the app crate has a single import path.

nodes.name: computer_use_lock.rs
nodes.summary: File-based, PID-checked exclusive lock ensuring only one session runs desktop Computer Use automation at a time, with reentrant same-session semantics and process-exit-safe release via a Drop guard.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses O_EXCL atomic file creation for the mutual-exclusion primitive and a liveness probe on the stored PID to recover from stale locks left by crashed sessions.

nodes.name: external_ide.rs
nodes.summary: Detects installed external IDEs/editors (with version and last-used timestamps) across platform-specific install locations and exposes Tauri commands to open project folders in them or reveal them in the OS file manager.

nodes.name: github/client.rs
nodes.summary: Thin reqwest-based HTTP client wrapper for the GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs, handling bearer-token auth, ETag-based conditional GETs, and surfacing 401s as a canonical re-auth error.

nodes.name: github/commands/credentials.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands for resolving Git credentials for a remote, building safe `git clone` argv, cloning repositories, and validating the stored GitHub token.

nodes.name: github/commands/issues.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands and response models for listing, creating, and updating GitHub issues, plus issue comments, repo labels, and collaborators.

nodes.name: id_for_registry_name
nodes.summary: Maps a free-text registry/display name (e.g. from IDE metadata) to a known CliBinaryId enum variant via case-insensitive matching.

nodes.name: probe_cli_binary_version
nodes.summary: Spawns the resolved CLI binary with a version flag under a timeout and parses stdout/stderr into a CliVersionProbe result.

nodes.name: parse_version_string
nodes.summary: Extracts a semantic version substring from raw CLI --version output using pattern heuristics.

nodes.name: resolve_cli_binary_with_options
nodes.summary: Core resolution routine that tries process PATH, known install locations, and login-shell lookup in order to locate a CLI binary and records which source found it.

nodes.name: find_on_process_path
nodes.summary: Searches the current process's PATH environment variable for a matching executable.

nodes.name: known_locations_for
nodes.summary: Returns a platform-specific list of well-known install directories to check for a given CLI binary id.

nodes.name: resolve_via_login_shell
nodes.summary: Unix implementation that spawns the user's login shell to resolve a command via its interactive PATH, capturing platform shell quirks not visible to the app's own PATH.

nodes.name: run_shell_command_with_timeout
nodes.summary: Runs a shell command with a bounded timeout, killing the child process if it exceeds the deadline to avoid hanging CLI detection.

nodes.name: parse_command_v_path
nodes.summary: Parses the output of `command -v` / `which`-style shell probes into a resolved path.

nodes.name: command_path_candidates
nodes.summary: Generates candidate executable paths for a command name within a directory, accounting for platform executable extensions.

nodes.name: is_executable_file
nodes.summary: Checks whether a filesystem path points to a file with executable permissions.

nodes.name: CliBinaryId
nodes.summary: Enum of every supported coding-agent CLI binary (Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Codex, Copilot, and 25+ others) that the app can detect and launch.

nodes.name: CliBinaryResolution
nodes.summary: Result of resolving a CLI binary, bundling the metadata, resolved command, and the resolution source (process PATH, login shell, known location, or fallback).

nodes.name: read_lock
nodes.summary: Reads and deserializes the on-disk lock file, if present, into a LockPayload.

nodes.name: is_process_running
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given PID still corresponds to a live process, used to detect and recover stale locks.

nodes.name: try_create_exclusive
nodes.summary: Attempts to atomically create the lock file with O_EXCL, falling back to stale-lock recovery if creation fails because a dead process's lock remains.

nodes.name: try_acquire
nodes.summary: Attempts to acquire the Computer Use lock for a session, returning Acquired, Reentrant (same session already holds it), or Blocked (another live session holds it).

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: Releases the lock file if held by the given session, verifying session ownership before deleting it.

nodes.name: request_abort
nodes.summary: Signals an in-progress Computer Use automation to abort and notifies the registered abort broadcaster.

nodes.name: force_release_on_exit
nodes.summary: Best-effort lock release invoked on process exit or panic to avoid leaving a stale lock behind.

nodes.name: server_detect_ides
nodes.summary: Tauri command that enumerates every supported IDE, resolves its CLI binary metadata, checks install status, and returns combined detection results to the frontend.

nodes.name: detect_ide_version
nodes.summary: Determines an installed IDE's version by reading app bundle metadata or invoking the IDE's CLI with a version flag.

nodes.name: parse_version_string
nodes.summary: Extracts a semantic version substring from raw IDE version output.

nodes.name: detect_last_used
nodes.summary: Determines when an IDE was last used by inspecting recent-files/workspace metadata on disk.

nodes.name: get_user_data_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the platform-specific user data directory for a given IDE, used to locate its config and recent-workspace files.

nodes.name: newest_mtime_in_dir
nodes.summary: Finds the most recently modified file's mtime within a directory tree.

nodes.name: build_app_path_map
nodes.summary: Builds a lookup map from IDE identifiers to their installed application bundle paths.

nodes.name: spotlight_date_to_iso
nodes.summary: Converts a macOS Spotlight metadata date string into an ISO-8601 timestamp.

nodes.name: collect_app_ide_paths
nodes.summary: Scans platform-specific application directories to discover installed IDE app bundles/executables for every supported CLI binary id.

nodes.name: try_open_app
nodes.summary: Attempts to launch an installed application, optionally passing a folder path argument.

nodes.name: generate_app_name_variants
nodes.summary: Generates alternate spellings/casings of an application name to improve app-launch matching heuristics.

nodes.name: open_in_external_ide
nodes.summary: Tauri command that opens a project folder in the specified external IDE application.

nodes.name: show_in_folder
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reveals a file or folder in the OS's native file manager.

nodes.name: open_folder
nodes.summary: Tauri command that opens a folder using the OS's default file manager/handler.

nodes.name: get_conditional
nodes.summary: Performs a GET request with ETag-based conditional caching, returning cached data on 304 and updating the ETag cache on 200, plus 401 re-auth error handling.

nodes.name: get_raw
nodes.summary: Performs a GET request and returns the raw response body honoring a custom Accept header, used for fetching file content.

nodes.name: graphql
nodes.summary: Sends a GraphQL query with variables to the GitHub GraphQL endpoint and returns the parsed JSON response.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Low-level HTTP request dispatcher shared by the REST helper methods, attaching auth headers and handling errors.

nodes.name: do_rest_request
nodes.summary: Builds and sends a REST API request for a given HTTP method, path, and optional body.

nodes.name: parse_response
nodes.summary: Parses an HTTP response into JSON, surfacing GitHub API error bodies and 401s as structured errors.

nodes.name: GitHubClient
nodes.summary: Authenticated GitHub API client bundling a reqwest HTTP client and bearer token, exposing REST and GraphQL helper methods used by every GitHub command handler.

nodes.name: build_clone_argv
nodes.summary: Builds the argument vector for a `git clone` invocation using an embedded token credential and optional branch.

nodes.name: github_git_credential_for_remote
nodes.summary: Resolves the Git credential (username/token) to use for a given remote URL.

nodes.name: github_clone_repo
nodes.summary: Tauri command that clones a GitHub repository into a target directory using the resolved credential token.

nodes.name: github_check_token
nodes.summary: Tauri command that validates the stored GitHub token by making an authenticated API call.

nodes.name: parse_issue
nodes.summary: Parses a raw GitHub API JSON value into a GitHubIssue struct.

nodes.name: parse_issue_comment
nodes.summary: Parses a raw GitHub API JSON value into a GitHubIssueComment struct.

nodes.name: github_list_issues
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists a repository's issues with optional state/label/assignee filters and pagination.

nodes.name: github_get_issue
nodes.summary: Tauri command that fetches a single issue by number.

nodes.name: github_create_issue
nodes.summary: Tauri command that creates a new issue with title, body, labels, and assignees.

nodes.name: github_update_issue
nodes.summary: Tauri command that updates an existing issue's title, body, state, labels, or assignees.

nodes.name: github_list_issue_comments
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists comments on an issue with pagination.

nodes.name: github_create_issue_comment
nodes.summary: Tauri command that posts a new comment on an issue.

nodes.name: github_list_repo_labels
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists the labels defined on a repository.

nodes.name: github_list_repo_collaborators
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists a repository's collaborators.
